subject: Request: onboarding rate exception for Altrum Health – VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding rate exception for Altrum Health – VP/CFO signoff

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Quick escalation — Altrum Health (large regional health system) is pressing to close the POC and get started on a long-term on-prem deployment. They asked for a starter discount (40% off list) for the first 12 months citing multi-year commitment & integration complexity. Procurement has delivered a counterproposal that we can’t accept without leadership signoff.

Why this matters:
- They will commit to a 3-year license + managed private deployment (reserved capacity).
- Expected run-rate after year 1 is ~ $1.2M ARR; first-year revenue is lumpy due to extended onboarding and integration support.
- Legal has minor redlines, procurement is pushing for the onboarding discount as a non-negotiable.

Ask: can we get a VP/CFO exception to authorize a 40% starter discount + $120k one-time onboarding credit to accelerate deployment? I’ve attached the SOW and updated pricing model. If we cannot approve, the customer will push the decision to their executive procurement and look at an alternative vendor.

Attachments: [Attachment: Altrum_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: pricing-model_v2.xlsx (Excel, 220KB)]

If helpful, I can draft a short exec memo for Marcus with revenue impact and precedent. Need a yes/no by end of day Tuesday to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Request: onboarding rate exception for Altrum Health – VP/CFO signoff

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the heads-up.

High-level thoughts (for the exec memo):
- Precedent: we’ve supported up to 35% starter discounts for strategic healthcare pilots, but only paired with aggressive usage milestones and revenue protection clauses.
- Financial impact: need clear ARR ramp (month-by-month) and gross margin for year 1 if we take the $120k credit.
- Operational risk: on-prem deployments have historically required 18–22% higher services investment.

Can you add a one-page forecast (monthly revenue + expected token consumption) and a short list of proposed guardrails (ex: milestone-based discounts, true-up at month 12, minimum committed spend)? I’ll draft the memo for Marcus and highlight any precedent.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding rate exception for Altrum Health – VP/CFO signoff

Naomi / Jonas — thanks for pulling this together.

We should narrow the ask before we involve finance. 40% + $120k credit feels high without hard guardrails. Proposed counter: 25% discount for first 12 months + $60k onboarding credit, conditioned on:
- Signed mutual-action-plan with milestone-based payment triggers (M1: infra ready, M2: model validation, M3: go-live).
- True-up clause at month 12 that resets pricing if actual usage exceeds forecast by >20%.
- Minimum committed ARR in year 2 (suggested $900k).

If Altrum pushes back, escalate to Marcus for one-time deeper exception but we should show that we tightened the ask to protect revenue. Naomi — please add a short summary of why 25%/60k is acceptable commercially (win probability, competitive risk, strategic value).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — attached and updated. I pushed back with procurement and put forward Marissa’s tightened ask (25% + $60k credit) to keep the deal moving. They came back with a counter to keep 40% and reduce the one-time credit to $80k.

Summary of the revised financials (attached spreadsheet tab: "ExecSummary"):
- Yr1 revenue (post-discount, expected): $420k
- Yr2 expected ARR (post-go-live ramp): $1.05M
- Gross margin impact Yr1 (est.): -12% vs. list due to onboarding credits & services uplift
- Payback: we still expect full payback before month 15 if usage tracks forecast and commitments are honored.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing-model_v2.xlsx], [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx]

Next steps I propose:
1) We present Marissa’s 25%/60k ask to Marcus with the attached one-pager (forecast + guardrails).
2) If Marcus approves, Naomi will present the updated proposal to Elena/Devon tomorrow and request final signatures on the M.A.P.
3) If Marcus declines, we ask for a limited one-time exception (max 35%/80k) and require an exec-level sponsor from Altrum.

I’ve also added the HubSpot link in the memo. Need signoff by EOD Tuesday to avoid losing the preferred start date.

Thanks,
Naomi
